name: @app/mistral-design-system
//: Dependency-only workspace member: it exists only when mistral-design-system is selected, and carries the pins apps/web's design-system code imports (the published capability package imports none of them, so they are not its dependencies) so apps/web/package.json stays plain JSON. The app links hoisted, so apps/web resolves them from the root node_modules. `@mistralai/ui` is private, and only this capability's .npmrc maps its scope to the app's index. The CLI renders .hbs files between its two installs, so this manifest is a .hbs (with no handlebars in it) to reach the app in the same phase as .npmrc: as a plain file it would be copied before the first install, which would fetch `@mistralai/ui` from public npm and fail. The atelier and capability packages keep it as an optional peer, so this is the one pin.
